A DNA extraction protocol that yields clean and homogeneous UHMW DNA is essential for good UL sequencing output. The choice of protocol should be based on achieving these parameters. We provide alternatives to achieve this by following kit-based or kit-free extraction protocols as follows: Kit-free, phenol-based : a scaled-down version of Josh Quick's protocol ( dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.mrxc57n ) with additional glass bead step for DNA precipitation. Kit-free, phenol-free : a modification of NEB's Monarch HMW DNA Extraction Kit for Cells & Blood, with the option to use SDS or CTAB in the lysis buffer. This protocol also uses glass beads as the DNA precipitation matrix. Circulomics Nanobind CBB Big DNA Kit : initially the recommended extraction protocol for UL sequencing using SQK-ULK001. New England Biolabs (NEB) Monarch HMW DNA Extraction Kit for Cells & Blood : a quick, tweakable extraction protocol fitting for a one-day library prep We optimized the above protocols in human cell lines. Quantify and calculate %CV as described in this paper by Koetsier and Cantor . Typically we take three measurements of 1 μl each on Nanodrop and one measurement of 3 μl using the Qubit DNA BR kit (standardized by the Jurkat genomic DNA). Qubit dsDNA BR (Broad Range) assay Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32850 Jurkat Genomic DNA Thermo Fisher Catalog #SD1111

This section provides an alcohol-free purification of a nanopore DNA sequencing library from an UL protocol. For 5-40 μg of input UHMW DNA (corresponding to DNA extracted from 1-6 million human cells), add 3 clean glass beads into the sample in a 2 ml tube. For DNA amounts less than 5 μg, 2 glass beads can be used (see table at step 19). Two slightly larger glass beads from New England Biolabs (NEB; see Materials) can also be used per reaction. Glass beads can be washed following an acid-, bleach-, or SDS-wash protocol then sterilized. Sterilization can be by autoclaving or just storing the beads in 70% Ethanol.

To start DNA extraction, choose one protocol from below:

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Sample a total of 10 µl DNA from four positions (top, upper‑middle, lower‑middle, bottom) – 2.5 µl each – using a cut P10 tip (or a positive‑displacement pipette if available); combine into a 2 ml tube and measure concentration with Qubit fluorometer and purity with Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 2.5 µl from each of the four locations using a cut P10 tip; if the sample is viscous, cut the DNA thread by pushing the tip against the tube bottom.
Combine the four 2.5 µl aliquots into a 2 ml tube.
Measure DNA concentration with the Qubit fluorometric assay.
Measure DNA purity (A260/280, A260/230) with the Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Add bead and vortex
steps.instruction: Add one glass bead to the DNA tube and pulse‑vortex at maximum speed (≈2400 rpm) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Quantify RNA carry‑over (optional)
steps.instruction: Use the Qubit RNA Broad Range kit on an aliquot of the sample; ensure the RNA concentration is less than 50 % of the DNA concentration measured by Qubit.

steps.title: Assess DNA length distribution (optional)
steps.instruction: Evaluate extracted DNA by visual methods such as regular agarose gel electrophoresis, pulsed‑field gel electrophoresis (e.g., Pippin Pulse), Agilent Bioanalyzer, or TapeStation.

steps.title: Add CoHex solution
steps.instruction: Add an equal (1:1) volume of 10 mM Hexamminecobalt(III) chloride (CoHex) to the DNA solution; for ONT ULK001 clean‑up the total volume is typically 500–1000 µl.

steps.title: Rotate tube to mix
steps.instruction: Mix the tube by rotation: use a vertical rotator at 9 rpm for 5 minutes if DNA < 5 µg, up to 10 minutes for up to 40 µg; if a rotator is unavailable, invert the tube by hand 30–40 times (≈5 s per cycle).

substeps.instruction: Place tube on a vertical rotator set to 9 rpm and rotate for the appropriate time based on DNA amount (5 min for <5 µg, up to 10 min for 40 µg).
If no rotator is available, invert the tube slowly by hand 30–40 repeats, each full cycle taking about 5 seconds.

steps.title: Invert tube three times
steps.instruction: Invert the tube by hand three additional times to ensure DNA precipitates and binds tightly to the beads.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the DNA‑bead precipitate.

steps.title: First PEGW wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml PEGW buffer, gently invert 2–3 times, incubate 3 minutes at room temperature, then discard most of the supernatant while avoiding disturbance of the precipitate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml PEGW buffer to the tube.
Gently invert the tube 2–3 times.
Incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard most of the supernatant, taking care not to disturb the DNA precipitate.

steps.title: Second PEGW wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash with 500 µl PEGW buffer, invert gently, incubate 3 minutes at room temperature, then discard the supernatant leaving a small residual volume.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl PEGW buffer.
Gently invert the tube.
Incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant, leaving a small amount of liquid to avoid drying the beads.

steps.title: Insert bead retainer
steps.instruction: Place a bead retainer into a collection tube.

steps.title: Transfer beads and pulse‑spin
steps.instruction: Pour the beads into the bead retainer and pulse‑spin in a mini‑centrifuge for 1 second (or the shortest possible time) to remove residual wash buffer; keep the bead retainer. (Dry‑spin may be omitted for large DNA amounts.)

substeps.instruction: Pour the beads from the previous step into the bead retainer.
Pulse‑spin the retainer for 1 second in a mini‑centrifuge (or the shortest time possible).
Retain the bead retainer for the next step.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Quickly transfer the beads into a new 2 ml low‑bind tube and immediately add the appropriate volume of elution buffer (ONT‑EB or 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0) as specified; do not let the beads dry out. The buffer can be pre‑aliquoted before adding the beads.

substeps.instruction: Pour the beads into a fresh 2 ml low‑bind tube.
Add the required volume of elution buffer (ONT‑EB or 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0) according to the protocol table.
Mix gently to resuspend the beads, avoiding bead drying.

steps.title: Incubate elution at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 30 minutes; every ~10 minutes gently aspirate and dispense the eluate over the beads with a wide‑bore P200 tip to aid elution.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube at 37 °C for a total of 30 minutes.
At ~10‑minute intervals, gently aspirate and dispense the eluate over the beads using a wide‑bore P200 tip.

steps.title: Centrifuge beads
steps.instruction: Insert the bead retainer into a clean 1.5 ml tube, pour the beads into the retainer, and centrifuge at 12 000 × g (≈12 000 rpm) for 1 minute at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Place the bead retainer with beads into a clean 1.5 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Final incubation with mixing
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes, mixing regularly with a pipette.

steps.title: Store or load library
steps.instruction: Store the library at 4 °C or proceed to loading; load at least 1 µg for MinION sequencing (or the entire library for 1 million input cells).

steps.title: Prime flow cell
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell according to the MinION or PromethION protocol (see manufacturer video).

steps.title: Quantify library concentration
steps.instruction: Measure 2–3 µl of the library using the Qubit DNA BR kit or, alternatively, a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Mix library with sequencing buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 38–40 µl of library (or at least 1 µg) with an equal volume of sequencing buffer (SQB) from the SQK‑ULK001 or SQK‑RAD004 kit; incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Mix library and SQB in a 1:1 ratio (38–40 µl each or ≥1 µg library).
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Load library and tether
steps.instruction: Load the library‑SQB mixture onto the flow cell following the SQK‑ULK001 protocol; allow tethering for 30 minutes before starting the run.

substeps.instruction: Load the mixture onto the flow cell as described in the SQK‑ULK001 protocol.
Incubate for 30 minutes to allow tethering before initiating sequencing.

steps.title: Select sequencing script
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate ultra‑long sequencing script for the kit used; the default mux scan is set to run every 6 hours.

steps.title: Prepare nuclease flush (optional reload)
steps.instruction: Mix 2 µl DNase I with 398 µl nuclease flush buffer (NFB) and vortex to combine.

steps.title: Remove priming port bubbles
steps.instruction: After opening the priming port, inspect for bubbles; set a P1000 to 200 µl, insert the tip into the port, and turn the wheel until the dial reads 220–230 µl or until buffer is seen entering the tip, thereby drawing back a small volume to eliminate bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Set the P1000 pipette to 200 µl.
Insert the tip into the flow‑cell priming port.
Turn the wheel until the display reads 220–230 µl or until a small volume of buffer enters the tip, drawing back liquid to remove bubbles.

steps.title: Load nuclease flush
steps.instruction: Using the P1000, load 400 µl of the NFB + DNase I mixture into the flow‑cell priming port.

steps.title: Incubate flow cell
steps.instruction: Close the priming port and incubate the flow cell in situ for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Reprime flow cell
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 24–26 (remove bubbles, load nuclease flush, incubate) as needed.

substeps.instruction: Perform the bubble‑removal, nuclease‑flush loading, and 1‑hour incubation steps again.

steps.title: Reload library
steps.instruction: Repeat library quantification, mixing with sequencing buffer, and loading steps (steps 19–21) to reload the same flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the library (2–3 µl) again.
Mix library with equal volume of SQB and incubate 30 minutes at room temperature.
Load the mixture onto the flow cell and tether for 30 minutes before the next run.
